findings.summary: Exported JSON wrapper has no production caller.
findings.consequence: The server auto-import/API surface includes a transport helper that production code does not use, while the only behavioral coverage exercises the wrapper itself. That leaves an extra public utility to maintain without reducing complexity for current editor reader behavior.
findings.evidence: The owned export begins at line 118. Repository search found only the definition, generated Nuxt import metadata, and test/unit/editor-reader-html.spec.ts references; the editor route imports fetchBoundedEditorText, fetchTimedEditorHead, maximumEditorHtmlLength, and sanitizeEditorEtextHtml, but not fetchBoundedEditorJson.
findings.recommendation: Delete fetchBoundedEditorJson and its dedicated unit-test assertions unless there is an intended upcoming production caller; callers that need JSON can compose fetchBoundedEditorText with JSON.parse at the call site where the expected response shape can be validated.
